newsitem.title: USA: Cosby witness fails to identify suspect -report.
newsitem.headline: Cosby witness fails to identify suspect -report.

text.p: A witness to the slaying of Ennis Cosby failed to identify the prime suspect in a police lineup, the Los Angeles Times reported on Thursday.
The Times said the development could raise significant doubts about the strength of the case against 18-year-old Mikail Markhasev.
Markhasev was arrested March 12 on murder charges for allegedly shooting Cosby, 27, the son of comedian Bill Cosby, in January as the victim changed a tire near the San Diego Freeway.
Defence attorney Charles Lindner told the Times he was told the witness "categorically eliminated" Markhasev as a suspect at the lineup.
The only known witness is a woman who Cosby apparently called to the scene after getting the flat but before being shot.
Markhasev's lawyer did not identify her as the one who viewed the lineup.
A spokeswoman for the district attorney's office would not comment on the report.
